title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame $$`lunch_{mat}`$$ contains columns for `person`, $$`calories_1 d_{ago}`$$, $$`calories_2 d_{ago}`$$, and `calories`. These represent the person, calories consumed $$1$$ day ago, calories consumed $$2$$ days ago, and calories consumed today, respectively.

title: Linear Regression Coefficients
text: In linear regression, `model.coef_` contains the coefficients for the features used in the model. The index `(ii)` refers to the position of the coefficient you want to extract.

title: Identify the Coefficient Index
text: Which index in `model.coef_` corresponds to $$`\theta_1`$$, the coefficient for $$`calories_1 d_{ago}`$$?
